name: DocXtractor
observations: Full-stack document data extraction platform
Users define Extractors (schema + system prompt), upload files/URLs, trigger Runs that parse documents and extract structured JSON data using AI models (Gemini, Ollama/Qwen)
Tech stack: NestJS backend, React 19 + TanStack Start frontend, Python workers (parser-service, extraction-service)
Infrastructure: PostgreSQL, Redis (BullMQ), MinIO, Ollama
Docker Compose for deployment; Ollama runs on host accessed via host.docker.internal:11434

name: NestJS Server
observations: Located in server/ directory, Port 3001
Modules: ExtractorsModule, RunsModule, FilesModule, QueueModule, AuthModule, OllamaModule, MailModule, InstanceSettingsModule, InviteModule
TypeORM with synchronize:true (auto-sync to PostgreSQL, no migrations)
Swagger at /api (basic auth: admin/admin), JSON spec at /api/swagger.json
All routes JWT-protected by default via global AccessTokenGuard; use @Public() for public endpoints
Global guards order: ThrottlerGuard > AccessTokenGuard > RolesGuard
ESLint flat config + Prettier, @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any is off
Commands: pnpm run start:dev, build, test, lint

name: React Client
observations: Located in client/ directory, Port 5174
React 19 + TanStack Start + TanStack Router (file-based routing in src/routes/)
TanStack Query v5 via Orval-generated hooks into src/api/endpoints/, src/api/models/, src/api/schemas/
Run pnpm run gen:api after backend DTO/controller changes
Custom Axios instance in src/lib/axios.ts with JWT auto-attach and 401 token refresh
Auth state: Zustand store in src/lib/auth-store.ts (cookie-persisted)
Real-time: socket.io-client subscribing to /runs namespace
UI: Custom RetroUI neobrutalist components + Radix UI + Tailwind CSS v4
Modals: @ebay/nice-modal-react, Forms: react-hook-form + zod, Tables: TanStack Table, Code editor: Monaco
Linting: Biome v2 (tabs, double quotes for JS), pnpm run check
Path alias: @/* maps to ./src/*

name: Parser Service
observations: Python worker in workers/parser-service/, Port 8001
Consumes uploaded-documents BullMQ queue
Uses Docling + RapidOCR to convert documents/URLs to Markdown
Fetches files from MinIO via boto3
Concurrency: PARSER_CONCURRENCY env var (default 4)

name: Extraction Service
observations: Python worker in workers/extraction-service/, Port 8002
Consumes extraction-requests BullMQ queue
Two modes: Google Gemini API (gemini-2.0-flash-exp) or LangExtract (supports Ollama)
Returns structured JSON
Concurrency: EXTRACTION_CONCURRENCY env var (default 3)
Needs .env with GOOGLE_API_KEY and LANGEXTRACT_API_KEY

name: Data Pipeline
observations: Upload > NestJS [FilesModule+RunsModule] > uploaded-documents queue > Parser Service > parsed-documents queue > NestJS [RunsModule] > extraction-requests queue > Extraction Service > extraction-completed queue > NestJS > React Client via Socket.IO
4 BullMQ queues: uploaded-documents, parsed-documents, extraction-requests, extraction-completed
Queue names in server/src/shared/queue/queue-names.ts
NestJS consumers extend WorkerHost in queue-consumers.ts
Python workers use bullmq Python package with Redis URL

name: Auth Flow
observations: Immich-style first-run admin setup + invite system + optional cloud signup
First run: no users > /setup > POST /auth/admin-setup > creates admin + instance settings
Self-hosted: admin creates invites (POST /invites) > users accept via /invite/:token
Cloud mode: allowPublicSignup > magic link email verification
Google OAuth optional, configured in admin UI
SMTP & OAuth stored in DB via InstanceSettings entity (not env vars)
MailService reads SMTP config from InstanceSettingsService (DB)

name: Extractor Entity
observations: Fields: schema (JSONB), systemPrompt, fewShotExamples (JSONB), extractionProvider enum (doclo|langextract|ollama)
ExtractorsModule calls Ollama to generate schemas from natural language

name: Run Entity
observations: Fields: status (pending>queued>parsing>extracting>done/failed/cancelled/review), sources (JSONB array), extractionResult (JSONB), processingMode (unified|per_document)
Batch mode with Ollama provider uses Promise.allSettled for parallel extraction

name: File Entity
observations: Fields: storageKey, bucket, status enum, metadata (JSONB)
Stored in MinIO, managed by FilesModule

name: User Entity
observations: UUID PK, email, passwordHash, googleId, role (user/admin), isEmailVerified

name: InstanceSettings Entity
observations: Singleton settings entity in server/src/instance-settings/
Stores SMTP config and Google OAuth config in DB
InstanceSettingsModule is @Global

name: WebSocket Events
observations: Namespace: /runs via RunsGateway
Rooms: run:{runId}, runs:list
Client events: joinRun, leaveRun, joinRunsList, leaveRunsList
Server events: run:updated, run:source:updated, run:log, runs:list:updated

name: Infrastructure Ports
observations: React Client:5174, NestJS API:3001, PostgreSQL:5433, Redis:6380, MinIO API:9005, MinIO Console:9006, Parser:8001, Extraction:8002, Ollama:11434

name: Dev Workflow
observations: New API endpoint: 1) Create in server/src/<module>/ 2) Restart server 3) pnpm run gen:api in client/ 4) Use generated hooks
Server: pnpm run start:dev, test, lint | Client: pnpm run dev, build, gen:api, check
Docker: docker-compose up -d --build
ChatModule removed from app.module.ts (was medical assistant, not core)
NotificationModule was never imported (dead code) - now has optional config
